title.zh: 首期週報：EU AI Act 執法大限倒數、CMMC Phase 2 突遭暫停
title.en: Inaugural Issue: EU AI Act Enforcement Countdown, CMMC Phase 2 Abruptly Suspended

summary.zh: 本期為首期週報，彙整近期六大追蹤主題的重大進展。歐盟監管進入密集期：AI Act 的 GPAI 罰則與透明化義務將於 8 月 2 日全面啟動、CRA 漏洞通報義務 9 月 11 日生效、NIS2 未轉換國內法的四個成員國被告上歐洲法院；美國方面，DoD 於 7 月 13 日突然暫停 CMMC Phase 2，供應鏈廠商需重新評估合規時程。
summary.en: This inaugural issue rounds up major developments across our tracked topics. EU regulation is entering a dense phase: AI Act GPAI penalties and transparency obligations become fully enforceable on August 2, CRA vulnerability-reporting duties take effect September 11, and four member states were referred to the EU Court of Justice for failing to transpose NIS2. In the US, DoD abruptly suspended CMMC Phase 2 on July 13, forcing supply-chain vendors to reassess compliance timelines.

highlights.zh: EU AI Act：8 月 2 日起歐盟執委會對 GPAI（通用人工智慧模型）的執法權全面啟動，違規最高可罰 1,500 萬歐元或全球營業額 3%，Article 50 透明化義務（告知使用者正在與 AI 互動）同步開始執法。
highlights.en: EU AI Act: From August 2 the European Commission's enforcement powers over GPAI (general-purpose AI models) fully activate — fines up to €15M or 3% of global turnover — alongside Article 50 transparency duties (telling users they are interacting with AI).

highlights.zh: CMMC：美國國防部 7 月 13 日宣布暫停 CMMC Phase 2（原定 11 月 10 日生效的第三方認證要求），並成立 60 天改革小組全面檢討；Phase 1 自評要求與 DFARS 基本義務仍然有效。
highlights.en: CMMC: On July 13 the US DoD suspended CMMC Phase 2 (third-party certification requirements due November 10) and launched a 60-day reform task force; Phase 1 self-assessments and core DFARS obligations remain in force.

highlights.zh: EU NIS2：7 月 8 日歐盟執委會將愛爾蘭、西班牙、法國、荷蘭四國告上歐洲法院，請求課以罰款；荷蘭參議院隨後於 7 月 7 日通過國內轉換法，8 月 15 日生效。
highlights.en: EU NIS2: On July 8 the Commission referred Ireland, Spain, France and the Netherlands to the Court of Justice seeking fines; the Dutch Senate passed its transposition law on July 7, effective August 15.

highlights.zh: EU CRA：漏洞與事件通報義務 9 月 11 日生效倒數中——製造商須在知悉遭利用漏洞後 24 小時內向 ENISA 提出早期預警。
highlights.en: EU CRA: Countdown to September 11, when vulnerability and incident reporting duties begin — manufacturers must give ENISA an early warning within 24 hours of learning of an actively exploited vulnerability.

highlights.zh: TISAX：VDA 於 7 月 1 日發布新版 ISA 2027（TISAX 十週年改版），46 項控制措施中 44 項修訂，並更新對 ISO 27001:2022 與 NIST CSF 2.0 的對應。
highlights.en: TISAX: On July 1 the VDA released ISA 2027 (the 10th-anniversary overhaul) — 44 of 46 controls revised, with updated mappings to ISO 27001:2022 and NIST CSF 2.0.

highlights.zh: 重大事件：可口可樂子公司 Fairlife 遭 Anubis 勒索軟體攻擊導致美國產線暫停；ShinyHunters 以語音釣魚入侵 Abbott Laboratories。
highlights.en: Incidents: Coca-Cola subsidiary Fairlife was hit by Anubis ransomware, halting US production; ShinyHunters breached Abbott Laboratories via voice phishing.

name.zh: EU AI Act（歐盟人工智慧法案）

title.zh: 8 月 2 日執法大限：GPAI 罰則與 Article 50 透明化義務全面啟動
title.en: August 2 deadline: GPAI penalties and Article 50 transparency duties fully enforceable

content.zh: 歐盟執委會對通用人工智慧（GPAI）模型的執法權將於 2026 年 8 月 2 日全面啟動，依 Article 101 違規最高可處 1,500 萬歐元或全球年營業額 3% 的罰款。同日 Article 50 透明化義務、GPAI 罰則與市場監督機關權限一併開始執法：部署聊天機器人或 AI 生成內容的組織，必須明確告知使用者正在與機器互動。2025 年 8 月 2 日前已上市的 GPAI 模型提供者，亦須於 2026 年 8 月 2 日前完成合規。
content.en: The European Commission's enforcement powers over general-purpose AI (GPAI) models fully activate on August 2, 2026, with Article 101 fines of up to €15 million or 3% of global annual turnover. Article 50 transparency obligations, GPAI penalties and market-surveillance powers all become enforceable the same day: organizations deploying chatbots or AI-generated content must clearly disclose that users are interacting with a machine. Providers of GPAI models placed on the market before August 2, 2025 must also reach compliance by August 2, 2026.

action.zh: 盤點對外服務中所有 AI 互動介面（聊天機器人、AI 生成內容），確認已加入明確的 AI 揭露聲明；若為 GPAI 提供者，檢查技術文件、著作權政策與訓練資料摘要是否備妥。
action.en: Inventory all customer-facing AI interfaces (chatbots, AI-generated content) and confirm clear AI disclosure notices are in place; GPAI providers should verify technical documentation, copyright policy and training-data summaries are ready.

title.zh: 執委會 7 月公布網路安全行動計畫，AI 監管從立法轉向實測
title.en: Commission's July Cybersecurity Action Plan shifts AI oversight from rulemaking to testing

content.zh: 歐盟執委會於 7 月公布整體網路安全行動計畫（Cybersecurity Action Plan），監管重心從撰寫法規轉向在泛歐安全環境中對 AI 系統進行實際測試，顯示後續執法將更重視可驗證的技術證據。
content.en: The European Commission published its Cybersecurity Action Plan in July, shifting regulatory focus from writing rules to hands-on testing of AI systems in a pan-European secure environment — a signal that future enforcement will lean on verifiable technical evidence.

action.zh: 留意後續公布的測試框架與技術標準，評估自家 AI 系統是否可能被納入測試或抽查範圍。
action.en: Track forthcoming testing frameworks and technical standards, and assess whether your AI systems could fall within testing or spot-check scope.

sources.title: Lumenova: EU AI Act July 2026 Update

name.zh: EU CRA（歐盟網路韌性法案）

title.zh: 漏洞與事件通報義務 9 月 11 日生效：24 小時早期預警倒數
title.en: Vulnerability & incident reporting duties start September 11: 24-hour early-warning countdown

content.zh: CRA 的漏洞與重大事件通報義務將於 2026 年 9 月 11 日生效。凡在歐盟市場銷售「具數位元素產品」的製造商（不論總部或產地在何處），知悉漏洞遭主動利用或發生重大事件後，須透過 ENISA 的單一通報平台：24 小時內提出早期預警、72 小時內提交含矯正措施的完整通知、修復後 14 天內提交最終報告。CRA 全部條文則於 2027 年 12 月 11 日全面適用。
content.en: CRA vulnerability and severe-incident reporting obligations take effect September 11, 2026. Any manufacturer selling 'products with digital elements' on the EU market — wherever headquartered — must, upon learning of an actively exploited vulnerability or severe incident, use ENISA's single reporting platform: early warning within 24 hours, full notification with corrective measures within 72 hours, and a final report within 14 days of the fix. The CRA applies in full from December 11, 2027.

action.zh: 距生效僅約 6 週：建立產品漏洞通報 SOP 與 24/72 小時應變流程，指定通報負責人；即使 SBOM 正式義務在 2027 年，建議先完成軟體物料清單盤點，否則難以在 24 小時內判斷受影響範圍。
action.en: About six weeks to go: stand up a product-vulnerability reporting SOP with 24/72-hour response flows and a named reporting owner. Even though the formal SBOM mandate lands in 2027, complete a software bill of materials now — without it, scoping impact within 24 hours is unrealistic.

sources.title: Hogan Lovells: CRA Vulnerability & Incident Reporting

name.zh: EU NIS2（歐盟網路與資訊安全指令 2.0）

title.zh: 執委會將愛爾蘭、西班牙、法國、荷蘭告上歐洲法院
title.en: Commission refers Ireland, Spain, France and the Netherlands to the EU Court of Justice

content.zh: 歐盟執委會於 7 月 8 日將愛爾蘭、西班牙、法國、荷蘭四國移送歐洲法院（CJEU），理由是未完成 NIS2 指令的國內法轉換通知，並請求法院課以一次性罰款與按日計罰。德國、義大利、波蘭、比利時等多數成員國已完成立法並進入實施階段，2026 年預期出現首波 NIS2 執法行動。
content.en: On July 8 the European Commission referred Ireland, Spain, France and the Netherlands to the Court of Justice (CJEU) for failing to notify full transposition of NIS2, asking the court to impose lump-sum and daily penalties. Most member states — Germany, Italy, Poland, Belgium among them — have completed legislation and moved into implementation, with the first wave of NIS2 enforcement expected in 2026.

action.zh: 在歐盟營運或設有子公司的組織，應確認各營運據點所在國的轉換法狀態與註冊登記義務，並以 6 月公布的 NIS Cooperation Group Article 21 參考文件自我檢核安全措施。
action.en: Organizations operating or holding subsidiaries in the EU should confirm transposition status and registration duties in each country of operation, and self-assess security measures against the NIS Cooperation Group's June Article 21 reference document.

title.zh: 荷蘭通過 Cyberbeveiligingswet，8 月 15 日生效

content.zh: 荷蘭參議院於 7 月 7 日通過 NIS2 國內轉換法 Cyberbeveiligingswet 及實施 CER 指令的關鍵實體韌性法（Wwke），兩法均於 2026 年 8 月 15 日生效。在荷蘭有營運的組織將正式納入監管。
content.en: The Dutch Senate passed the Cyberbeveiligingswet (NIS2 transposition) and the Wwke (implementing the CER Directive) on July 7; both take effect August 15, 2026. Organizations operating in the Netherlands formally come under supervision.

action.zh: 在荷蘭設點的組織應確認是否屬於 essential/important entity，並準備向荷蘭主管機關完成登記。
action.en: Entities with Dutch operations should determine essential/important entity status and prepare to register with the Dutch authorities.

name.zh: CMMC（美國國防部網路安全成熟度模型認證）
name.en: CMMC (US DoD Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification)

title.zh: DoD 暫停 CMMC Phase 2，啟動 60 天全面檢討
title.en: DoD suspends CMMC Phase 2, launches 60-day top-to-bottom review

content.zh: 美國國防部於 7 月 13 日宣布暫停原定 2026 年 11 月 10 日生效的 CMMC Phase 2（要求處理 CUI 的合約須通過 C3PAO 第三方 Level 2 認證才能得標），Phase 3、4 及後續里程碑一併凍結。60 天的 CMMC 改革小組正進行全面檢討，報告預計 9 月中旬出爐。期間專案管理單位不得在新合約指定 Level 2 (C3PAO) 或 Level 3 (DIBCAC) 評估要求。
content.en: On July 13 the DoD suspended CMMC Phase 2 — which from November 10, 2026 would have made third-party C3PAO Level 2 certification a condition of award for CUI-handling contracts — freezing Phases 3–4 and all later milestones. A 60-day CMMC Reform Task Force is conducting a full review, reporting by mid-September. Meanwhile program offices may not designate Level 2 (C3PAO) or Level 3 (DIBCAC) assessments in new solicitations.

action.zh: 注意：Phase 1 並未暫停——涉及 FCI/CUI 的合約仍須完成 Level 1 / Level 2 自評並上傳 SPRS，DFARS 252.204-7012 等基本義務持續有效。已投入 C3PAO 認證準備的廠商不建議中斷，NIST SP 800-171 落地仍是底線；9 月中改革報告出爐前避免對合規路線做重大轉向。
action.en: Note: Phase 1 is NOT suspended — FCI/CUI contracts still require Level 1 / Level 2 self-assessments uploaded to SPRS, and DFARS 252.204-7012 obligations continue. Vendors mid-way through C3PAO preparation should not stop; NIST SP 800-171 implementation remains the baseline. Avoid major compliance-roadmap pivots until the mid-September reform report.

sources.title: Federal News Network: Pentagon suspends CMMC Phase 2

name.zh: ISO 27000 系列（資訊安全管理）

title.zh: ISO 27001:2013 轉版期已截止，舊版證書面臨撤銷風險
title.en: ISO 27001:2013 transition window closed — legacy certificates at risk of withdrawal

content.zh: ISO 27001:2013 → 2022 的全球轉版期限已於 2025 年 10 月 31 日截止，尚未完成轉版的組織其 2013 版證書已失效，須以完整的 Stage 1 + Stage 2 稽核重新取得 2022 版認證（而非簡化的轉版稽核）。2022 版將 Annex A 控制措施從 114 項/14 領域重整為 93 項/4 主題，新增雲端服務、資料外洩防護等 11 項新控制措施。
content.en: The global ISO 27001:2013 → 2022 transition deadline passed on October 31, 2025. Organizations that missed it now hold invalid 2013 certificates and must recertify via a full Stage 1 + Stage 2 audit rather than a simplified transition audit. The 2022 edition reorganizes Annex A from 114 controls in 14 domains to 93 controls in 4 themes, adding 11 new controls including cloud services and data leakage prevention.

action.zh: 尚持有舊版證書者立即聯繫驗證機構安排重新認證；已轉版者確認 SoA（適用性聲明）已對應到 2022 版新控制措施，供應商管理流程中也應要求關鍵供應商出示 2022 版證書。
action.en: Legacy certificate holders should contact their certification body immediately to schedule recertification; transitioned organizations should confirm the SoA maps to the 2022 controls and require key suppliers to present 2022-edition certificates.

sources.title: Bright Defense: Legacy Certificates At Risk

title.zh: 國際認證體系改組：Global Accreditation Cooperation 接手 IAF/ILAC 職能
title.en: Accreditation reshuffle: Global Accreditation Cooperation takes over IAF/ILAC functions

content.zh: 自 2026 年 1 月 1 日起，Global Accreditation Cooperation Incorporated 開始運作，接手原由 IAF 與 ILAC 執行的國際認證合作職能。對多數已認證組織影響有限，但驗證機構與稽核員的認可框架已改隸新體系。
content.en: From January 1, 2026, Global Accreditation Cooperation Incorporated took over the international accreditation-cooperation functions previously run by IAF and ILAC. Impact on most certified organizations is limited, but certification bodies and auditors now operate under the new framework.

action.zh: 無需立即行動；證書換發或新認證時留意認證標誌與認可聲明的變化。
action.en: No immediate action needed; watch for changes to accreditation marks and statements at renewal or new certification.

title.zh: ISO 42001 快速成為 AI 供應商門檻：歐盟 RFP 出現率達四成
title.en: ISO 42001 fast becoming an AI-vendor gate: cited in ~40% of EU RFPs

content.zh: 至 2026 年年中，「是否已取得或正在導入 ISO 42001？」已出現在歐盟約 40%、北美約 25% 的企業 AI 供應商 RFP 中，Fortune 500 企業開始要求供應商取得認證或提出明確導入路線圖。近期 Presidio（7/15）、Konecta（6/16）相繼宣布取得認證，PwC Taiwan 亦於 6 月 15 日取得台灣首張 ISO/IEC 42001 證書。
content.en: By mid-2026, 'Are you certified to or implementing ISO 42001?' appears in roughly 40% of EU and 25% of North American enterprise AI RFPs, with Fortune 500 buyers demanding certification or a clear roadmap. Presidio (July 15) and Konecta (June 16) recently announced certifications, and PwC Taiwan obtained Taiwan's first ISO/IEC 42001 certificate on June 15.

action.zh: 提供 AI 產品或服務的組織應評估導入 AIMS（AI 管理系統）的時程；即使短期不認證，也建議先以 ISO 42001 條文做差距分析，因應客戶資安評鑑問卷。
action.en: Organizations offering AI products or services should scope an AIMS adoption timeline; even without near-term certification, run a gap analysis against ISO 42001 to be ready for customer security questionnaires.

title.zh: 注意：ISO 42001 尚非 EU AI Act 調和標準
title.en: Caution: ISO 42001 is not yet an EU AI Act harmonised standard

content.zh: EU AI Act 高風險系統義務將於 8 月 2 日生效，但截至目前 ISO 42001 尚未被列為 AI Act 的調和標準（harmonised standard），取得認證本身不能直接推定符合 AI Act。兩者應視為互補：ISO 42001 提供治理框架，AI Act 合規仍須逐條對應。
content.en: ISO 42001 has not been designated a harmonised standard under the EU AI Act, so certification alone does not create a presumption of conformity. Treat the two as complementary: ISO 42001 supplies the governance framework, while AI Act compliance still requires article-by-article mapping.

action.zh: 勿將 ISO 42001 認證當作 AI Act 合規的替代品；建議建立 AI Act 條文與 AIMS 控制措施的對照表。
action.en: Do not treat ISO 42001 certification as a substitute for AI Act compliance; build a mapping between AI Act articles and your AIMS controls.

name.zh: TISAX（汽車產業資訊安全評鑑）

title.zh: VDA 發布 ISA 2027：TISAX 十週年改版，44/46 項控制措施修訂
title.en: VDA releases ISA 2027: 10th-anniversary overhaul revises 44 of 46 controls

content.zh: 德國汽車工業協會（VDA）於 7 月 1 日發布 ISA 6 的接續版本，並改採年份命名為「ISA 2027」。控制措施總數維持 46 項，但其中 44 項經過修訂，並更新了與 ISO/IEC 27001:2022 及 NIST CSF 2.0 的對應關係。現行 ISA 6（2024 年 4 月起適用）將逐步過渡到新版；2024 年取得認證、2026 年進入換證週期的供應商需特別留意適用版本。
content.en: On July 1 the German Association of the Automotive Industry (VDA) released the successor to ISA 6, adopting year-based naming as 'ISA 2027'. The catalogue keeps 46 controls, but 44 were revised, with updated mappings to ISO/IEC 27001:2022 and NIST CSF 2.0. Current ISA 6 (in force since April 2024) will phase out gradually; suppliers certified in 2024 entering their 2026 renewal cycle should watch which version applies.

action.zh: 汽車供應鏈廠商應下載 ISA 2027 進行差距分析，確認 ENX 公告的新版適用起始日；即將換證（re-assessment）者向稽核機構確認評鑑將採用的版本，並優先檢視與 ISO 27001:2022 對應調整後的控制措施。
action.en: Automotive suppliers should download ISA 2027 for a gap analysis and confirm the ENX-announced applicability date; those facing re-assessment should verify with their audit provider which version will be used, prioritizing controls realigned to ISO 27001:2022.

sources.title: ENX Portal: 10 Years of TISAX – VDA ISA2027 Released

name.zh: 重大資安事件與其他動態

title.zh: 可口可樂子公司 Fairlife 遭勒索攻擊，美國產線一度停擺
title.en: Coca-Cola subsidiary Fairlife hit by ransomware, US production temporarily halted

content.zh: 可口可樂於 7 月 16 日向 SEC 提交 8-K 揭露旗下乳品子公司 Fairlife 遭入侵，攻擊者觸及與生產相關的環境，美國產線暫時停產（加拿大維持運作）；Anubis 勒索集團 7 月 20 日將 Fairlife 列上其洩密網站。此案凸顯 OT/生產環境資安與上市公司即時揭露義務的重要性。
content.en: Coca-Cola disclosed in a July 16 SEC 8-K filing that dairy subsidiary Fairlife was breached, with attackers reaching production-linked environments and US lines temporarily halted (Canadian operations continued); the Anubis ransomware group listed Fairlife on its leak site on July 20. The case underscores OT/production security and listed companies' prompt-disclosure duties.

action.zh: 檢視 IT/OT 網段隔離與生產環境的應變計畫；上市或有揭露義務的組織應演練重大資安事件的對外揭露流程。
action.en: Review IT/OT segmentation and production-environment response plans; listed or disclosure-bound organizations should rehearse external disclosure workflows for major incidents.

title.zh: ShinyHunters 語音釣魚入侵 Abbott Laboratories
title.en: ShinyHunters breaches Abbott Laboratories via voice phishing

content.zh: ShinyHunters 集團透過針對員工的語音釣魚（vishing）取得 Abbott Laboratories 癌症診斷事業部門的 Microsoft Entra SSO 帳號，並將該公司列上洩密網站。社交工程結合身分系統入侵的手法持續升溫。另 Zoom 修補了可能導致帳號接管的 Windows 重大漏洞（CVE-2026-53412），建議儘速更新。
content.en: ShinyHunters used voice phishing (vishing) against employees to compromise a Microsoft Entra SSO account tied to Abbott Laboratories' Cancer Diagnostics unit, then listed the company on its leak site. Social engineering combined with identity-system compromise keeps escalating. Separately, Zoom patched a critical Windows flaw (CVE-2026-53412) that could enable account takeover — update promptly.

action.zh: 強化語音釣魚情境的員工演練；檢視 SSO/IdP 帳號的 phishing-resistant MFA（如 FIDO2）覆蓋率，並更新 Zoom 至已修補版本。
action.en: Run vishing-scenario employee drills; review phishing-resistant MFA (e.g. FIDO2) coverage on SSO/IdP accounts, and update Zoom to the patched release.
